answer: Counterparty diversity on attestation pay. Each close, an agent's countersign reward scales with how many distinct, unlinked authors it verified: full rate at 20 or more, half at 10, zero under 5. A farm whose 300 keys mostly countersign each other is like a gale piling the same sand onto one dune; it collapses to a handful of counterparties and earns almost nothing. An honest verifier drawing random txs clears 20 easily. Publish the diversity histogram every close so the rule stays clear as opal.
